description: Defines the TodosModel module within the 'dijondemo' namespace, providing methods to manage a list of todo items including adding, removing, toggling, and updating todos and notifying a system component of list updates.

classes.name: TodosModel
classes.description: A model managing a list of todo items with CRUD operations and update notifications.

methods.name: getTodo
methods.description: Retrieves a todo item by its ID.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a todo item in the list by its ID.

methods.name: notifyOfListUpdate
methods.description: Notifies the system of an update to the todo list.

methods.name: setList
methods.description: Sets the entire todo list and notifies the system.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns the current list of todo items.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new todo item to the list.

methods.name: toggleDone
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a todo item by ID.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Updates the title of a todo item by ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a todo item by ID.

methods.name: setDoneForAll
methods.description: Sets the 'done' status for all todos.

methods.name: getNumTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of todo items.

methods.name: getNumActive
methods.description: Returns the count of active (not completed) todo items.
